key_difference: On EBUSY, (B) simply closes the descriptor and retries unlink() (also for ETXTBSY/EPERM) inside a file-local static helper. (D) instead adds new private-header API, including a Q_AUTOTEST_EXPORT function, and performs a rename-to-temp / dev+ino check / rename-back dance via QFileSystemEngine::renameFile. The reviewers had already pushed back on that rename approach (link+unlink fallback on non-local filesystems). It also opens windows where the lock name is briefly absent, or a foreign lock gets stranded under a .removing.XXXXXX name if the restore fails, which can break mutual exclusion and leave stray files.
